name: dasd-workspace
description: npm workspace root for the web apps (orchestrator · higgsfield · finance · calendar). The Python projects and the vanilla dashboard are NOT part of this workspace — see CLAUDE.md 'Framework exception'.

scripts.dev:orchestrator: concurrently -n orch-api,orch-web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @dasd/orchestrator-server" "npm run dev -w @dasd/orchestrator-web"
scripts.dev:higgsfield: concurrently -n higg-api,higg-web -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w @dasd/higgsfield-server" "npm run dev -w @dasd/higgsfield-web"
scripts.dev:finance: concurrently -n fin-api,fin-web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dasd/finance-server" "npm run dev -w @dasd/finance-web"
scripts.dev:calendar: concurrently -n cal-api,cal-web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @dasd/calendar-server" "npm run dev -w @dasd/calendar-web"
